baseline.observed: Check Point discovery job 37e7b54a-65ea-4e45-9a8b-a36386f79558 failed with 'management command failed: TimedOut[]' after enumerating 5 valid domains. Execution timed out during queryObjects because EXEC_TIMEOUT is only 30 seconds, SshExecTransport leaves stdin open without channel.setInputStream(null), and SshExecTransport never drains channel.getErrStream() which can deadlock on filled stderr pipe buffers.
baseline.what_exists: ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter has fixed EXEC_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(30) which is too short for multi-domain MDS CMA network_objects queries. SshExecTransport.exec() connects without channel.setInputStream(null) and only reads in.available() while ignoring channel.getErrStream(). ManagementShellCommands.contextSwitchAndObjectQuery redirects mdsenv to /dev/null but leaves cpmiquerybin stderr unredirected.

invariants: Opaque identity handling: stable identifiers preserved
report.objective: Increase Check Point discovery exec timeout to accommodate multi-domain CMA query execution times, harden SshExecTransport against stdin/stderr pipe stalls, and add INFO-level per-domain/per-object-type query telemetry.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Fixing SSH transport streams, timeout extension, and discovery query logging

requirements: In ManagementPlaneEnumerationAdapter.java: increase EXEC_TIMEOUT from Duration.ofSeconds(30) to Duration.ofSeconds(180). In queryObjects, log at Level.INFO when starting: 'Executing Check Point object query for domain {0}, type {1}', measure execution time, and log at Level.INFO upon success: 'Check Point object query succeeded for domain {0}, type {1}: parsed {2} objects in {3}ms'.

In SshExecTransport.java: in exec(...), call channel.setInputStream(null); before channel.connect. Retrieve InputStream err = channel.getErrStream(); and in the while (true) loop, drain err.available() > 0 into a byte buffer/drain so that remote processes writing to stderr do not block on pipe buffers.

In ManagementShellCommands.java: in contextSwitchAndObjectQuery, append ' 2>/dev/null' after cpmiquerybin invocation to prevent stderr pollution and buffer blocks: 'loginShell("source /etc/profile.d/CP.sh; mdsenv " + quote(domainIdentifier) + " >/dev/null 2>&1 && cpmiquerybin object \"\" network_objects \"type='" + objectTypeFilterValue(objectType) + "'\" 2>/dev/null");'. Ensure CLOSED_COMMAND_PREFIXES continues to match.
In ManagementShellCommandsClosedSetTest.java: verify tests pass with the updated command string.
Run ./ui2/gradlew -p ui2 :worker:test to verify all tests pass.
